review.description: S1-S5 retain comparison semantics, mapping ownership, stable IDs and pinned adoption. New classification/browser assertions are mapped under existing scenarios, with no gate policy changes. Reviewed the explicitly approved trigger coverage reduction. S5 continues to require exact selected-event verification and successful main-push artifact provenance; those existing contracts remain accurate.
review.implementation: Reviewed unchanged specs tooling and current catalog mappings; rendered only registry-owned sections and kept glossary foundational. Reconciliation receipts are produced by the CLI against exact main after required verification. Approved CI trigger selection now runs pushes only on main and retains PR-to-main/manual events. Exact comparison, fixture, bootstrap and main-push release implementations are unchanged; feature branches without PRs and manual parent-base limitations are documented. Current cycle changes only failed synthetic delivery cancellation and disconnected awaiting-answer takeover in questions.go. Reviewed this consumer against those narrow changes; its authored behavior and implementation remain consistent, with existing gaps retained.
review.tests: Existing schema/report/runner tests remain unchanged and selected. New source/test paths are covered by explicit flow/assertion anchors, and validate verifies all references before recorded reconciliation. Read HostedCITests exact push/PR/manual Git histories, bootstrap rejection, fixture-forcing runner and successful-main-push-only release assertions. Existing integrations were rerun after the trigger/docs edit. Direct workflow inspection verifies main-only push selection and retained PR/manual events; no test mirrors YAML spelling.
